briefing: Markets were flat and mixed today (NASDAQ +0.1%, S&P500 -0.3%), not a clear risk-on signal, so we held back from deploying most of our open slots. INVX stood out as the only candidate with all four confirming signals (momentum, trend, price structure, and volume), so we added a high-conviction position there while leaving cash and two slots in reserve for a stronger setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means a price move is backed by unusually high trading activity, which suggests real institutional buying rather than a random blip. When RSI, MACD, and price trend all line up alongside a volume surge, the signal is much more trustworthy than any single indicator alone.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 成交量確認是指價格變動伴隨著異常放大的交易量,代表背後有真實的機構買盤,而非隨機波動。當RSI、MACD與價格趨勢同時配合成交量放大時,這個訊號的可信度遠高於單一指標。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded in a narrow, mixed range today with NASDAQ essentially flat and the S&P 500 slightly lower, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts. Without a clear market-wide trend, the better approach was to focus on individual stocks with strong technical confirmation rather than chasing the broader tape. INVX's combination of rising momentum, a bullish MACD crossover, and surging volume made it an exception worth acting on even in an otherwise quiet session.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢窄幅震盪,NASDAQ幾乎平盤,標普500則小幅走軟,顯示市場缺乏明確的方向性催化劑。在大盤趨勢不明的情況下,與其追逐整體市場走勢,更好的做法是聚焦在個股的技術面確認訊號。INVX同時出現動能轉強、MACD黃金交叉及成交量放大,是少數值得在淡靜交易日中進場的例外標的。

trades.reasoning: Top-scored candidate (100) with full multi-signal confirmation — bullish RSI, MACD crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge indicating real institutional participation.
